verdict.rationale: Publishing service hours, daily limits or session timeouts before filing is a fair question for a government online-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not mention any operating-hours window, per-day limit or session timeout for the online trade mark or patent flows. The only up-front disclosures are fees, the One Login credential requirement and a paper fallback, which are related but different features.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
